description: This Java class represents a 'Country' entity in a sales management system, including fields for country identification, descriptions, zones, geozones, and configuration flags. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Entity class modeling a country with properties such as id, isoCode, support status, associated zones, descriptions, and geozone.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the country (transient, not stored in database).

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the country (transient).

methods.name: Country
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the country with an isoCode.

methods.name: getSupported
methods.description: Returns whether the country is supported.

methods.name: setSupported
methods.description: Sets whether the country is supported.

methods.name: getIsoCode
methods.description: Returns the ISO code of the country.

methods.name: setIsoCode
methods.description: Sets the ISO code of the country.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the country.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the country.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Returns the list of zones associated with the country.

methods.name: setZones
methods.description: Sets the list of zones associated with the country.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions for the country.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for the country.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Returns the geozone associated with the country.

methods.name: setGeoZone
methods.description: Sets the geozone for the country.
